what_changed: Rescoped to a 1:1 art redesign of the existing character. No new mechanics, no wall cling, no 36-frame expansion. Same movements the game already ships, denser cycles, tuxedo + grey variants, in the labelled movement-sheet format.

character.name: Cat Hero
character.summary: Chunky tuxedo cat — black coat with white bib, muzzle and paws — and the same cat in grey. Oversized round head, short legs, heavy paws, thick tail. Same character as today's atlas, redrawn with more frames and better acting.
character.style: 16-bit pixel art, 1 px ink outline, flat fills, 2-step shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradient

canvas.hitbox_note: Body inside 34x42 above the foot line; tail, ears and swipe arc may overflow. Existing footprint ceiling 87x66.

animations.name: walk
animations.notes: full 8-frame cycle: contact, down, passing, up, contact, down, passing, up

animations.name: run
animations.notes: body pitched forward, two fully airborne frames

animations.name: jump
animations.notes: rise, apex, fall, land-ready. Game currently picks 3 poses by vy; the 4th is available for the landing frame

animations.name: swipe
animations.notes: KEPT DELIBERATELY: the sheet has no attack row, but the game's combat and the boss fight depend on it

animations.name: specials
animations.notes: curl sleep, idle play, stretch, yawn

mechanics.note: No wall cling, no new ability, no physics change. Rows map onto the existing anim names: walk, run, jump, bat (swipe), rest/sleep (specials). Frame counts are data-driven by cat-atlas.json, so denser cycles need no code change.

acceptance: 28 frames per variant, 56 total, in the documented row order
every frame faces right, feet on the foot line
body inside 34x42; tail/ears/swipe arc may overflow
opaque pixels are Apollo colours only (tolerance 0)
binary alpha, no halo, no background, no text in the generated art
tuxedo and grey share identical poses and timing
